title: Directing Today's Payment to a Deferred-Interest Plan — Crestline Credit Card
content:
A cardholder who has made a payment today may direct it, before the day's allocation runs, to the deferred-interest plan whose period ends last on the account, the longer plan where two end on the same day; this rule figures the part of today's payments the direction sends to that plan, for a Crestline Credit Card account carrying at most one purchase on each deferred-interest plan.

Second, a cardholder may instruct that amounts above the minimum go to a particular deferred-interest plan; the instruction is the cardholder's own request and applies from the next payment that posts after it is submitted, except that a direction the cardholder gives on the day a payment posts, before that day's allocation runs, applies to that day's payments and sends to the named plan the part figured under this rule.

## When the direction is settled

A payment direction is not fixed until the returned payment fee charged for a payment made toward the latest statement, when it meets the returned-payment courtesy conditions, carries its courtesy credit.

A payment direction is not fixed until the deferred interest owed on a plan whose promotional period ended since the latest statement closed stands assessed on the account.

Restated in the same terms: while such a returned payment fee meets those conditions without carrying its courtesy credit on the card ledger, or while such a plan's deferred interest does not yet stand assessed on the account, the part the direction sends is not fixed.

## Recording the direction: `direct_payment_to_plan_c5f7b721`

**Capability.** The cardholder directs part of one of their own payments on a Crestline Credit Card account to one of their deferred-interest promotional purchases. One call records one allocation of that payment to that purchase, dated today, citing the payment and the purchase, for the amount passed; it writes only that allocation entry and changes no other record.

**How it is invoked.** This is the cardholder's own tool: the agent unlocks `direct_payment_to_plan_c5f7b721` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | reference number of the cardholder's Crestline Credit Card account, read from the card account lookup | identifier text |
| `payment_reference` | confirmation number of the payment being directed, exactly as the payment shows it | PMT- followed by 9 digits |
| `source_card_txn_id` | ledger entry reference number of the promotional purchase the cardholder names, read from the card ledger lookup of that account | identifier text |
| `statement_date` | closing date of the statement the payment was made toward, exactly as the payment shows it | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `amount` | the part of the payment directed to the purchase | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; kept rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` (always "directed" on success), `card_txn_id` (reference of the new allocation entry), `payment_reference`, `source_card_txn_id`, `statement_date`, `amount` (USD, 2 decimals) and `txn_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). The call succeeds whenever the account, the payment, the purchase, the statement and the amount are supplied; the tool checks no condition and computes no figure.
